title: send_read_receipts(): Message/set update readAt in event.rs
description:
**What:** Implement async send_read_receipts() that marks a list of messages as read via JMAP Message/set update.

**Algorithm:**
1. Function signature: pub(crate) async fn send_read_receipts(http_client: &reqwest::Client, api_url: &str, message_ids: &[String]) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>
2. If message_ids is empty, return Ok(()) immediately without any HTTP call.
3. Generate readAt = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(chrono::SecondsFormat::Millis, true).
4. Build update map: for each id in message_ids, insert id -> {readAt: readAt_string}.
5. Build JmapRequest: method_call 'Message/set', args: {accountId: 'a-self', update: update_map}.
6. Call client::call_jmap(...).await — propagate error via ?.
7. Extract method_responses[0]. If method name is 'error', return Err with the error type.
8. Check args['notUpdated'] — if non-empty, log to stderr 'read receipt failed for N messages' but return Ok(()) (non-fatal; best-effort delivery).
9. Return Ok(()).

**Defensive rules:**
- Empty slice must short-circuit BEFORE building any request object.
- notUpdated failures are non-fatal — log to stderr only, never crash or propagate error.
- readAt timestamp must be chrono RFC 3339 UTC, not local time.
- Never log message IDs (could leak conversation metadata).

**Agent team:** R reads event.rs (existing JMAP pattern); I implements; T writes tests with wiremock; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.
